cronJob.description:
The {@link CronJob} schedule calling the the {@link FieldStoredCalcCacheBatchJob}.
Used to retrieve the relevant, enabled {@link FieldStoredCalcCache#cronJob}s to evaluate.
Ignored if #fieldStoredCache is specified.

fieldStoredCache.description: The instance of the {@link FieldStoredCalcCache} that this batch job will evaluate.

overrideFilterSpec.description:
Override the {@link FieldStoredCalcCache#filter} being applied on entities in the {@link FieldStoredCalcCache#srcType}.
The overridden filter will be applied to all {@link FieldStoredCalcCache}s.

batchSize.description:
Number of records in {@link FieldStoredCalcCache#srcType} to evaluate per batch.
This is used if there is no {@link FieldStoredCalcCache#batchConfig} specified.

title:
Configuration options for {@link FieldStoredCalcCacheBatchJob} operations.

Defines parameters for batch jobs that cache calculated field values on persisted entities.
Inherits from {@link FieldStoredCacheBatchJobOptions} to provide calculation-specific
configuration for processing {@link FieldStoredCalcCache} instances in batches.
name: FieldStoredCalcCacheBatchJobOptions
